label: Quest
description: In Ironforge, Talvash del Kissel has a Gnomeregan Gumdrop for a sick child in Stormwind. He asks for a train impression before handing it over.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Talvash del Kissel has a Gnomeregan Gumdrop for a sick child in Stormwind. He asks for a train impression before handing it over.

At Hallow’s End, trick-or-treaters seek treats from the Alliance strongholds. In Ironforge’s Mystic Ward, Talvash del Kissel keeps the Gnomeregan Gumdrop. He feels for the young orphan who wants it, but asks anyone seeking the sweet to bring some mischief to the holiday with a convincing train impression.

Jesper, an ailing orphan in Stormwind City, hopes for four treats from across the Alliance: nougat from Stormwind, a mint from Ironforge, marzipan from Darnassus, and a gumdrop from Gnomeregan. A chugging locomotive impression entertains Talvash and earns the gumdrop, bringing Jesper closer to his holiday wish.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Well now, even though you're doing something noble and collecting candies for a sick child, I can't let you off the hook that easily. I have a yummy Gnomeregan Gumdrop to give to the sick child... If you make a train noise for me! Haha, yes, that'll be the trick! The price of this gumdrop is one train noise!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Woo-woo! Well done, friend! Here's your treat.
